owner_instruction.message: 好 开始 M1-08 Exact Profile + Runtime Lifecycle Smoke 合同准备

findings_closed.issue: Attempt Guard was initially inside the runtime test root and would have been deleted by successful cleanup, allowing same-profile reuse.
findings_closed.fix: Moved Attempt Guard to persistent runtime-state path outside runtime test root; evidence also lives outside runtime root; guard and evidence explicitly survive successful cleanup.

findings_closed.issue: Windows path ownership and cleanup semantics did not explicitly reject reparse points/junctions/symlinks or prevent recursive deletion from escaping the test root.
findings_closed.fix: Added effectful write-root ancestry checks, reparse/junction/symlink/mount-point rejection, CREATE_NEW rules, no hardlinks for copied payload files, and cleanup that never follows reparse points.

findings_closed.issue: Atomic current-manifest publication and post-activation failure recovery were underspecified.
findings_closed.fix: Defined initial publish vs replacement semantics, no delete-current-then-rename, transition indices 1/2/3, post-publish hash/reparse verification, fault-injection requirements, and restoration of the last verified revision after post-activation probe failure.

findings_closed.issue: Source immutability evidence wording could be read as claiming the entire m1pkg002 directory was unchanged although only the lifecycle-bound payload needs to be normative.
findings_closed.fix: Narrowed source attestation to exact Q8_0 model + runtime archive + extracted runtime tree; whole package root unchanged claim explicitly false.

findings_closed.issue: Candidate initially pinned the M1-07 Owner Ed25519 root fingerprint for M1-08 without a separate Owner decision authorizing cross-task trust-root reuse.
findings_closed.fix: M1-08 issuer root is now unresolved in preparation. Final Issuance requires an explicit Owner decision to reuse an existing root or enroll a new M1-08 root, then bind the chosen public-key fingerprint in the reviewed effectful owner.

author_side_adversarial_self_review.note: Author-side remediation and reverse-check complete at current branch state; this is not an independent verdict and Fresh-Context re-review is still required.

findings_addressed.change: Require the exact guard parent to preexist and be verified safe before Final Issuance; the issued profile cannot create or recreate it; the first profile-owned filesystem write is atomic CREATE_NEW of the exact Attempt Guard file.

Define exact normal and failure-recovery current transitions, transition_kind, recovery_of_transition_index, recovery transition 3 for failed B probe and transition 4 for failed rollback-A probe, followed by terminal failure.
Enumerate and reject NTFS named alternate data streams on every bound source and slot regular file; copy semantics must preserve only the unnamed default stream.
Replace residual whole-package unchanged wording with exact bound-source-payload-set semantics.
Bind exact same-directory current temp paths for transition indices 1 through 4.
